retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s soul aesthetic featuring subjects standing on floating vintage cars against a stark white background with bold, stacked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two figures in dynamic, triumphant poses standing atop the hoods of two vintage luxury cars that appear to be floating or flying. The entire scene is isolated on a clean white background, with a heavy, multi-colored typographic block centered between the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two subjects and two vehicles
Typographic block acting as a central vertical anchor
High-contrast relationship between dark clothing/cars and white negative space
Diagonal lines created by the car angles and subject limbs
coreInvariants: Tight vertical leading in text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects at roughly 1/3 and 2/3 horizontal positions, scaled to appear as if standing on full-sized cars.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central text block in purple, red, and black.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the central car gap, then outward to the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central cluster, emphasizing the floating effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Purple, Vibrant Red, Olive Green
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation primary/secondary accents in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 3-4 distinct ink colors for text

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand scaled smaller and positioned as a connector

typesetting.case: Sentence case for names, Title case for title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying colors and sizes to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Rope-like lines held by subjects connecting to the cars

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque feel and heavy presence.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the title block.
Clean, neutral, and effective when tightly kerned.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of two 1960s luxury cars (like a Cadillac Eldorado) floating at slight angles against a pure white studio background. Two men in vintage 60s attire stand triumphantly on the hoods, holding thin white ropes. High-key lighting, sharp focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central stack of bold sans-serif text in the gap between the men. Use deep purple for the first line, bright red for the second, and black for the remaining title lines. Ensure the leading is very tight.

verificationChecks: Is the text heavy-weight and tightly stacked?
Are there distinct color changes in the text block?

mustRedesign: Ensure text does not have drop shadows
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the floating elements
Verify the text colors are solid and vibrant
Ensure the subjects look integrated with the cars
Confirm the composition feels balanced but dynamic
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Soul Aesthetic = (Floating Vintage Objects + Dynamic Human Poses) / (Pure White Space) + (Bold Stacked Grotesque Typography in Primary Colors)
